formText: Enter your registration ID and the phone number you registered with.

errors.notFound: We couldn’t find a registration with this ID and phone number. Check both and try again, or call us.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

explain.pending: We have your registration. Once you have paid, our team will confirm your payment — usually within 24 hours. Use your registration ID as the payment reference.
explain.confirmed: Your payment is confirmed and your place is secured. See you at the start line on 20 December 2026!
explain.failed: We have not received a payment for this registration. If you have paid, please call us with your transaction ID.
